record.question: Which of the following countries are the members of G7?
options: France, Germany, India, Japan, United Kingdom, United States and Canada
France, Germany, Italy, Russia, United Kingdom, United States and Canada
France, Germany, Italy, Japan, United Kingdom, United States and Canada
France, Germany, Italy, Japan, France, United States and Canada
record.explanation: Answer C: France, Germany, Italy, Japan, United Kingdom, United States and Canada. The seven G 7 countries are Canada, France, Germany, Italy, Japan, the United Kingdom and the United States. Only option C gives that set. The EU also participates, but is not an additional country in this seven-country list. Reference: https://www.consilium.europa.eu/media/23853/143078.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
